The pending-preview notice uses cooked text and remains visible while retaining the previous model. The A press at VI 309 occurs inside the first omitted disc wait and has no native input. Absent video VIs omitted by timestamp: 301, 591, 851. Original DVD transfer text/bar are excluded only on frames whose observed transfer state and model opacity prove that overlay is visible. All full-image differences remain diagnostic. Native loading text reflects real asset preparation, outside deterministic replay updates; no DVD timing or percentage is reproduced.
